title: Preserve exact meaningful whitespace in workspace file creation
goal: Ensure the canonical workspace.create-file Skill preserves user-supplied indentation and blank lines instead of trimming file contents during request parsing.
context: The Skill adapter currently trims the content suffix with whitespacesAndNewlines, silently changing source files and formatted text. The user explicitly supplied a content delimiter, so parser normalization must remove only the conventional delimiter separator and leave the actual payload intact.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken workspace path validation, Settings policy, Agent scope, module authorization, or read-back verification.
Do not change the existing create-file request grammar beyond preserving content after its explicit delimiter.
Do not claim physical-device verification from CI.
acceptance_criteria: Create-file parsing preserves indentation and blank lines in supplied content.
The canonical M8 Skill path writes the exact expected content and returns verified=true only after verification.
Existing Vietnamese and English create-file tests remain green.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the regression test reveals normalization elsewhere in the canonical path, fix the narrowest content-transforming boundary and keep exact-content read-back assertions.
